Founder population recipe for AlphaSimR

Source: R/alphasim.R
asr_founders.Rd

Describes how each replicate builds its founders and trait with AlphaSimR. Every replicate draws new founders from its own seed, and every design in a study uses the same seeds, so all designs start from the same founders (common random numbers).

Usage

asr_founders(
  n_founders = 50,
  n_chr = 20,
  seg_sites = 200,
  qtl_per_chr = 20,
  mean = 0,
  var = 1,
  plot_h2 = 0.3,
  species = "none",
  haplotypes = NULL,
  setup = NULL
)

Arguments

n_founders

Number of inbred founder lines.

n_chr

Number of chromosomes (soybean has 20).

seg_sites

Segregating sites per chromosome.

qtl_per_chr

QTL per chromosome for the additive trait.

mean, var

Founder mean and genetic variance of the trait.

plot_h2

Heritability of a single plot in the founders; sets the plot error variance.

species

"none" or a MaCS species history; see below.

haplotypes

Optional AlphaSimR MapPop to sample founders from.

setup

Optional function of SP (the SimParam) for anything else, such as extra traits (SP$addTraitAD()), genetic correlations or SNP chips. When given, it replaces the default trait.

Value

An asr_founders recipe.

Details

Any of these fields except setup and haplotypes can also be given to alphasim_program() or line_pipeline() as an argument, so they can be tuned or turned into scenarios, for example sim_scenarios(plot_h2 = c(0.1, 0.3)).

Where founder haplotypes come from

  • species = "none" (the default) draws founder haplotypes with AlphaSimR::quickHaplo(): fast and exactly reproducible from the seed, but without the linkage disequilibrium a real population history leaves.

  • species = "GENERIC", "WHEAT", "MAIZE", ... simulates a population history with MaCS (AlphaSimR::runMacs()). MaCS does not follow R's random seed, so tidyagsim keeps each replicate's founders in memory for the session: designs in one session share founders, but a new session (or a parallel worker) draws different ones.

  • haplotypes takes a MapPop you made yourself, for example from real marker data with AlphaSimR::importHaplo() or one MaCS run saved with saveRDS(). Each replicate samples n_founders of its individuals.

Examples

asr_founders(n_founders = 40, plot_h2 = 0.2)
#> # AlphaSimR founders: 40 inbred lines, 20 chromosomes x 200 sites (independent haplotypes)
#> # Trait: 20 QTL per chromosome, plot h2 0.2
